segments: Linh arrived at Ha Long Bay. The limestone islands were amazing! She was excited for her English summer camp. She wanted to learn a lot and see the beautiful nature. Panic began to rise. Her e-ticket was on this phone. To access it on another device, she needed a code from this very phone.

Because of this, Linh found Mr. Tan, the camp guide. She tried to explain her problem. "My phone... dead," she said, pointing to her black screen. "E-ticket... boat tour... no battery." "Here, try this," he offered. While her phone charged, Mr. Tan taught Linh some helpful phrases. "My phone is not working," he said. "I need help with my ticket."

Soon, Linh's phone charged enough to turn on. She quickly received the two-factor code. With a sigh of relief, she logged into her app and found her e-ticket! "Thank you, Mr. Tan!" she said, smiling. "My ticket is here. I am ready for the boat tour!" Mr. Tan smiled back.

Because of this, Linh boarded the boat with a big smile. The amazing views of Ha Long Bay unfolded before her eyes. She saw tall limestone islands and clear blue water. She felt proud. Her English skills helped her solve a big problem. This trip was more than just a vacation; it was a journey of learning and success.
endWrap: Linh learned that even small problems can be opportunities to grow. Her Ha Long Bay challenge made her more confident in English and herself.
